subject: Operational Readiness Certification: VPC Private Delivery - Final Signoff
body:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, alice.g@acme-payments.com
Cc: infra-team@acme-payments.com
Date: 2026-12-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Operational readiness certification for Acme VPC private delivery

Team —

Attached is the near-final operational certification packet for the VPC private delivery to Acme. This message is the formal request for an "operational readiness certification" (ORC) signoff from the deployment leads + Acme infra. The customer is targeting a controlled activation window on 2026-12-23 (US-West maintenance window).

Key asks before we mark ORC as green:
- Network: confirm BGP adjacency and eBGP route acceptance between Acme edge and our transit (check AS paths + route filters). See network-diagram-20261221.png.
- Security: ACLs and firewall rules validated for management plane (SSH/HTTPS) and data plane (model traffic ports).
- Runtime: KV-cache warm-up completed for representative seed set and latency profile verified (kvcache_warmup_log_20261222.txt).
- Observability: dashboards wired (per-route token-level latency + error rates), and PagerDuty rotation set for 48h post-activation.
- Rollback: warm standby plan and config snapshots captured in runbook_v2.pdf (section 6).

Please review the attached checklist + runbook and reply with one of: APPROVE / REQUIRES-FIX / HOLD. If APPROVE, include your operational acceptance note and any limiting conditions. If REQUIRES-FIX, list the specific items so we can convert into SUP tickets.

I will consolidate and escalate to leadership at 17:00 PT on 2026-12-22 for final decision.

Thank you —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Deployments, Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, connor_obrien@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, alice.g@acme-payments.com
Cc: infra-team@acme-payments.com
Date: 2026-12-21T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Operational readiness certification for Acme VPC private delivery

Hannah —

APPROVE with one operational caveat: the management-plane NAT gateway in the customer VPC currently has a 5-minute burst scaling lag that caused a single missed artifact fetch during a simulated config push. We verified artifact fetch succeeds on retry and configured a backoff in the agent to avoid chasing. Action items:
- I filed SUP-1974 to track a short-term mitigation (priority P2) and a post-window improvement (P3).
- Observability: I added a temporary heartbeat monitor to the "agent-config-fetch" metric.

Provided we include SUP-1974 in the runbook handoff and extend the observation window by 2 hours, I sign off. Network tests and KV warm-up are green from my side. Attach: runbook_v2.pdf (updated section 3.2) attached.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

---

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, alice.g@acme-payments.com
Cc: infra-team@acme-payments.com
Date: 2026-12-21T15:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Operational readiness certification for Acme VPC private delivery

Quick update from runtime/flight: APPROVE. Notes:
- KV cache: primed across the three model shards using the Acme sample corpus. Median token gen latency matches expectations (p50 42ms, p95 164ms) under the test harness. Full logs at kvcache_warmup_log_20261222.txt.
- Load shaping: continuous-batching configured to 32ms target and validated with 2k RPS synthetic for 10 minutes. No CPU-backed OOMs observed.
- Canary policy: we will start with 0.5% routed traffic for the first hour, then 5% for the second hour, provided error rates <0.5% and latency deltas <15%.

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Runtime Lead, Redwood Inference

---

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com, alice.g@acme-payments.com
Cc: infra-team@acme-payments.com
Date: 2026-12-22T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Operational readiness certification for Acme VPC private delivery

Hannah / team —

REQUIRES-FIX (minor) before I can fully signoff. Details:
1) Network egress rules: the DDoS mitigation appliance in Acme's edge path was dropping small UDP health probes used by our NAT detection; I coordinated a rule tweak with Acme infra and validated probes now pass. Please update runbook_v2.pdf with the probe ports (UDP 60000-60005).
2) Backup plan clarity: the runbook lists a "warm standby" but lacks the exact switch-over CLI sequence for the orchestration plane. I need a 4-step CLI snippet in section 6.2.

Once the two items above are added to runbook_v2.pdf and SUP-1974 is acknowledged in the handoff, I will provide full APPROVAL. I expect to re-check by EOD PT 2026-12-22.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Network and Capacity, Redwood Inference

---

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, alice.g@acme-payments.com
Cc: infra-team@acme-payments.com
Date: 2026-12-22T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Operational readiness certification for Acme VPC private delivery

Thanks all — final status below for the record and leadership: 

Summary: All items closed or acknowledged. SUP-1974 created for NAT burst mitigation (Marissa). DDoS probe port rule updated and documented (Markus). Runbook_v2.pdf revised with CLI snippet in 6.2 and probe ports; attached and uploaded to Confluence (link below). Connor validated runtime metrics; canary policy in place. Acme infra (alice.g) confirmed management plane access and firewall exceptions.

Decision: ORC = APPROVED. Activation scheduled 2026-12-23 01:00–03:00 PT (maintenance window). Post-activation observation: 4 hours with direct on-call (primary: marissa_cole, secondary: connor_obrien).

Next steps: 
- I will publish the official handoff doc to Confluence and attach the final runbook.
- Mark the Jira ticket SUP-1974 as linked to this deployment.
- Scheduling: Customer kickoff bridge 00:45 PT on 2026-12-23 -> Zoom link in Confluence page.

Thanks for the fast turn.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Deployments, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: runbook_v2.pdf (final), network-diagram-20261221.png, kvcache_warmup_log_20261222.txt

Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/pages/ACME-VPC-PROD
